what: every proc-macro call written in a workspace member at a non-empty dir (crates/app) was refused Limit(Paths); the same crate as a root package expanded. tempo: 321 call groups, 1,313 unresolved names, 9,867 items not checked behind them. The note printed only 'its ProcMacro read (Limit(Paths))': HostError is Copy and carries no words, so the sandbox's sentence was dropped at CallError::host_error.
cost: about an hour of reading; the cause was found by reading, not by a run, because the refusal named no path
cause: the checkout is "" when blaze runs in the workspace root, so a member's Files::Member workspace was PathBuf(""); the shim's chdir into /workspace/<dir> stats that folder through Files::real, and canonicalize("") is ENOENT: refused. A dir of "" stats the tree's root without asking Files::real, so root packages worked.
whys: '' means 'here' in the checkout's convention but not to the OS; Files::real took a path from the process's working folder with no rule for the empty one; and the refusal's words never reached the row, so the 4-second run could not show the path
class: a relative-folder convention ('' = here) handed to an OS call that does not share it; and a typed error (HostError) too small to carry the words of the refusal it stands for
prevention: done: Files::real reads '' as '.', its errors name the mount, not a machine path; the run's CallError words reach the names record's row through SourceTexts::proc_macro_unusable's ProcUnusable::Run; tests sandbox::seen_tests::a_member_of_a_checkout_named_here_is_entered_and_read, proc_callers::tests::a_member_of_a_checkout_started_in_is_entered, refused_rows::a_run_the_sandbox_stopped_is_refused_by_the_path_it_named. Open: blaze still reads files relative to its working folder (rule 75 would pass the root folder as a capability).
annoyance: the build queue's wait cannot be polled and editing is forbidden while it waits; a lane has little to do in that time but read
workaround: read ahead for the next piece while the ask waits
